test_results.name: Legitimate camera burst
test_results.condition: 35 packets from camera (baseline T=30, camera T=40)

test_results.name: Low-rate suspicious activity
test_results.expected: Unknown-IP detected; burst not triggered (documented limitation)
test_results.actual: UNKNOWN_IP detected: True. Burst missed (below threshold): True

test_results.name: Cooldown suppression and re-alert
test_results.condition: Trigger at t=0, suppress at t=1, re-trigger at t=10
test_results.expected: Suppression during cooldown, re-alert after cooldown

test_results.name: Privacy inspection
test_results.expected: No prohibited identifiers, payloads, or secrets

test_results.name: Unauthorized service detection
test_results.expected: UNAUTHORIZED_SERVICE alert generated with severity HIGH
